description:
Microsoft Bing search results: web, news, images, videos, shopping (with full product details and every store's offer) and maps places.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: query): Search
- news (required: query): News Search
- images (required: query): Image Search
- videos (required: query): Video Search
- shopping (required: query): Shopping Search
- product_details (required: product_id): Product Details
- maps (required: query): Maps Search

When to use: Use when Bing results are wanted. For Google results use realtime_web_search and the other Google tools.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_bing_search_data
